About.title: Movie, Series, and Book Log App & How to Use
About.subtitle: Movie, series, and book timelines without sign-up
About.description: ottline helps you keep OTT watch history from services like Netflix, TVING, and Disney+, along with films, series, and books, on your own timeline. Start on the web without signing up, then continue on the installable PWA, Android app, iOS app, Windows app, browser extension, or Toss in-app mini app. The ChatGPT connection is still in preparation.

About.platformsDesc: The web timeline is at the heart of ottline. Open the same records wherever it suits you.
About.platformWebDesc: Use it directly in the browser, then install it on your home screen or desktop to reopen it like an app.
About.platformTossDesc: Open your OTT timeline directly inside Toss without installing another app.

About.platformWindowsDesc: The same web app is also available through Microsoft Store packaging, so the desktop flow stays familiar.
About.platformAndroidDesc: Install from Google Play to reach the record window from your home screen, widget, or watch reminder settings.
About.platformIosDesc: Install from the App Store and continue the same records and timeline on iPhone.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
FAQ.heading: FAQ
FAQ.description: Find answers about data storage and sign-up free usage of ottline.
FAQ.q1: Q. How are records kept without signing up?
FAQ.a1: ottline uses Local-first storage. Your records are kept in your browser’s internal storage (IndexedDB) first, so you can return to them on the same device and browser without signing up. To move to another device, let your records sync and keep your record connection code.
FAQ.q2: Q. Can I see my records on a different device?
FAQ.a2: Yes! Find your record connection code in My space on a device that has your records, then enter it on the new device. Records from your devices can share the same timeline.
FAQ.q3: Q. How are records merged when I connect a device?
FAQ.a3: If both devices have a record for the same title, the most recently edited content is kept. This may replace the earlier content.
FAQ.q4: Q. How do I delete records?
FAQ.a4: Individual record deletion is not supported, but you can remove synced account data at once in My space > Delete all server data. If you only want to clear the current device, use My space > Reset local data.
FAQ.q5: Q. Can I download my records?
FAQ.a5: Yes. You can download a CSV file in My space > Export my records and organize it in Excel or Spreadsheets.
FAQ.q6: Q. Is there a usage fee?
FAQ.a6: All features are free. Keep your records at your own pace.
FAQ.guideTitle: Looking for a little more detail?
FAQ.guideDesc: Explore calm, step-by-step guides for OTT watch logs, movies and series, and books.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: ottline ("the Service") values your privacy and complies with relevant laws. This policy guides you through the items of information processed, purposes, storage methods, and user rights.
Privacy.section1List:
• Record data: Title, type, genres, watching or reading status, feeling, note, date, platform, place or occasion, season and episode
  • Sync data: Internal account and client identifiers used for pairing and synchronization
  • Recommendation data: Suggested titles and reasons, excluded titles, daily usage counts and request status
  • Service usage data: Session identifier, feature events, initial landing path, referring origin, and UTM source, medium, campaign, term, and content
  • Environment data: Device, browser, OS, and PWA or TWA installation status
Privacy.section2List:
• Storing and viewing records, building timelines, and providing sync
  • Providing requested title recommendations, applying exclusions, and managing daily recommendation usage
  • Analyzing errors and improving service stability
  • Aggregating acquisition paths and feature usage to improve the experience
Privacy.section3List:
• Synced records and account data are kept until you request My space > Delete all server data.
  • First-party analytics events are automatically deleted 180 days after collection.
  • Deleting an account also deletes analytics events that store its account identifier. Anonymous events without an account identifier cannot be matched to a specific person for selective deletion and are automatically deleted after 180 days.
  • Data sent to Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity is retained and deleted under each provider's configured settings and policies.
  • When the law requires retention, information is kept only for the required period.
Privacy.section4Desc: The Service uses Google Analytics 4 from Google and Clarity from Microsoft to aggregate visits and usage flows. Online identifiers such as cookies and environment information may be processed under each provider’s policy. Title recommendations use OpenAI as described below. The Service does not sell user information.
Privacy.section5Desc: Users may request access, correction, or deletion of their data. This can be done through My space > Delete all server data or by contacting the operator.
Privacy.section6Desc: Please submit privacy-related inquiries through our service channels. We will process them without delay after verification.
Privacy.recommendationDesc: When you request new stories in Future timeline, we send OpenAI the titles, types, genres, feelings, and any notes, places or occasions from up to 50 selected records, plus excluded titles. OpenAI returns suggested titles and reasons. Record connection codes and internal account or device identifiers are not included as recommendation input fields.
Privacy.recommendationStorage: Suggested titles and reasons, excluded titles, daily usage counts and request status are kept with your account for connected devices. They are deleted when you choose My space > Delete all server data. OpenAI processes and retains data under its applicable policies and settings.
